adrs.title: Runtime Topology and Architecture Authority
adrs.decision: Keep W01/W02/W03/W04 as the only independently deployable Workers at the current foundation baseline. Reliability and Placement/Migration remain capability domains. W05/W06 require a new approved topology ADR before independent deployment.
adrs.rollback_impact: Reopening Worker topology requires a new topology ADR and migration review.

adrs.title: Executable Governance Closure
adrs.decision: Complete R1 machine enforcement for legacy isolation, contracts, data ownership, runtime envelopes, release policy and expiring exceptions without adding Workers or product functionality.
adrs.rollback_impact: Reverting this ADR would reopen governance gaps and requires an explicit governance ADR.

adrs.title: W03 Write Path Control-Epoch Validation
adrs.decision: Model the existing W03 -> W04 control-epoch validation as an explicit service contract. Permit the W03 service binding to W04 while forbidding private implementation imports.
adrs.rollback_impact: Removing the dependency requires a replacement control-epoch validation contract and runtime verification.

adrs.title: Complete Foundation Capability Baseline
adrs.decision: Adopt the complete capability map as the long-term planning baseline, while keeping it non-authoritative for immediate implementation until Foundation Freeze promotion. Preserve W01-W04 deployment topology and require explicit contracts and governance promotion before capability implementation.
adrs.rollback_impact: Revising the capability baseline does not itself require a major version; changes to stable architecture or compatibility require the existing versioned ADR, migration and verification controls.
